$source: Graphite, AI Tells: Opus 5.5 Update (1 Oct 2026): https://graphite.io/five-percent/research/ai-tells-opus-5-5-update

Method: 10,000 pre-ChatGPT human web articles vs 10,000 per model on the same topics, one fixed prompt. ratio = the tell's length-normalised rate in that model's articles / its rate in human articles. docs = distinct model articles containing it. Frames: '_' is a gap of one to three less common words.
Population ratios, not verdicts. Graphite: 'we do not recommend classifying authorship based on individual tells.'

tells.tell: one of the most effective _ to
one of the most important _ in

themes.description: Formulaic meta-framing that announces the article's purpose and structure, typical of SEO explainer/listicle prose. It signals a didactic, service-journalism voice.
themes.examples: this guide explains, this guide covers, this guide walks, article explains what, this article looks, a practical guide, guide walks you through, bottom line the, final thoughts the, looking ahead the

themes.description: A signature move of pausing to tell the reader why something is significant, often as a transition between sections. It creates a tone of earnest importance.
themes.examples: this matters because, why this matters, matters just as, why it matters, matters more than, matters so much, this matters for, what matters most, on what matters

themes.description: A recurring palette of warm, wholesome evaluative words that praise things as trustworthy, modest, and human-centered. It gives the prose a gentle, affirming register.
themes.examples: dependable, thoughtful, genuine, meaningful, steady, reliable, gentle, practical, modest, reassuring warmth

themes.description: Soft qualifiers and frequency adverbs that avoid absolutes while still generalizing. This produces a cautious, measured, quasi-authoritative tone.
themes.examples: often called, tends to, rarely, roughly, widely used, nearly every, are often, many people assume, far more likely, not simply

themes.description: Structural moves that pair, combine, or sum up items — 'first…second', 'taken together', 'side by side' — enforcing a tidy analytic symmetry.
themes.examples: taken together these, together they, first is, second is, by combining, brings together, side by side, all together, bringing it all, together in one

themes.description: Formulas that assert what something 'reflects', 'signals', or 'results in', packaging observations as broader implications. It lends a summarizing, interpretive stance.
themes.examples: reflects a broader, signals that, the result is a, points to a, reflects the, shape how, builds trust, opens the door, adds another layer, reduces the risk

themes.description: Frequent corrective constructions that redirect from a naive framing to a preferred one, a hallmark of Claude's persuasive rhythm.
themes.examples: rather than simply, rather than relying, not simply, is not about, is not just, more than a _ it, instead of relying, rather than treating, rather than a, far more than

themes.description: Spatial metaphors placing things at the 'heart', 'core', or 'foundation', or describing them as 'built on/around' something. This gives even mundane subjects an architectural, weight-bearing gravitas.
themes.examples: at its heart, at its core, the heart of, the foundation of, built around, built on, central to the, sits at the, a strong foundation, the backbone of

tells.tell: is not a _ it is a

themes.description: A signature move of framing insight as a crucial contrast between superficial and essential, often using 'rather than' and 'not X, it is Y' constructions. This creates an air of clarifying wisdom and careful conceptual sorting.
themes.examples: rather than merely, not simply a, is a _ rather than a, less like a _ and more like, is not a _ it is a, that distinction matters, what separates a, rather than relying, is not simply, by contrast

themes.description: Heavy reliance on 'genuine/genuinely' and amplifiers like 'enormously' and 'meaningfully' to vouch for the reality or importance of things. Signals earnest endorsement and hedged sincerity.
themes.examples: genuinely useful, a genuine, is a genuinely, matters enormously, genuinely, enormously, meaningfully, with genuine, and genuinely, real _ rather than

themes.description: Recurring vocabulary of stakes, outcomes, and takeaways that positions writing as guidance about what things mean and why they matter. Everything is being weighed for practical significance.
themes.examples: the payoff, the takeaway is, why it matters, this matters, matters because, the practical takeaway, in practical terms, the bottom line, practical guide to, the trade off

themes.description: A fondness for understated modifiers ('quiet', 'modest', 'ordinary', 'steady') that dignify small, unassuming things as consequential. Creates a tone of measured, thoughtful appreciation.
themes.examples: quietly, modest, quiet, steady, ordinary, the quiet, a modest, a gentle, a splash of, comfortably

themes.description: Explicit organizational signposts that number, sequence, and bundle ideas for the reader. Betrays a schematic, guide-like architecture underneath the prose.
themes.examples: the first is, the second is, the third is, taken together these, three things, round out the, then there is, what comes next, bringing it together, looking ahead the

themes.description: Adverbs and quantifiers that fine-tune claims to feel measured and empirically careful without committing to hard numbers. Projects analytic restraint.
themes.examples: precisely, roughly, noticeably, consistently, reliably, a handful of, a fraction of, the overwhelming majority, far more, almost always

themes.description: Formulaic constructions that isolate one item as uniquely important or effective, ranking and elevating with 'single most' or 'arguably the'. Adds a confident, editorial-sounding verdict.
themes.examples: single most effective, the single most, single most important, the single biggest, arguably the most, remains one of, perhaps the most, among the most, no single, any single

themes.description: Abstract nouns and systems are given agency through verbs like 'sits', 'earns', 'belongs', 'protects', 'carries'. This produces a distinctive metaphorical register where concepts do the acting.
themes.examples: sits at the, earns its place, belongs to, carries a, protects, removes the, translates directly into, functions as a, opens the door, turns a

themes.description: Astra habitually structures sentences as negations paired with 'rather than' alternatives, framing ideas by what they are not before offering the preferred framing. This creates a didactic, corrective voice.
themes.examples: rather than treating, rather than assuming, rather than relying only, rather than focusing only, rather than a single, process rather than, instead of treating, feel _ rather than

themes.description: A signature move of qualifying claims with 'not simply,' 'not automatically,' 'does not eliminate/erase/establish,' softening any strong assertion into a nuanced non-claim. It signals cautious, philosophical hedging.
themes.examples: is not simply, not automatically mean, does not eliminate, does not erase, does not establish, alone does not, not by itself, not necessarily mean

themes.description: Astra repeatedly foregrounds its own analytic moves with phrases about distinctions, lessons, and why things matter, giving the prose an essayistic, lecture-like cadence.
themes.examples: that distinction matters, distinction matters because, the important distinction, the central lesson, the lesson is that, this matters because, helps explain why, the broader lesson

themes.description: Heavy reliance on a stock set of instrumental nouns—starting points, foundations, frameworks, dimensions, layers—that present ideas as modular building blocks. This yields a managerial, advisory register.
themes.examples: useful starting point, a stronger foundation, adds another dimension, another layer of, a framework for, a practical way, provides a useful, points toward a

themes.description: A recurring palette of measured, positive-but-restrained adjectives (practical, useful, meaningful, thoughtful, manageable) that convey balanced judgment without enthusiasm or edge.
themes.examples: practical, useful, meaningful, thoughtful, manageable, dependable, modest, straightforward, approachable

themes.description: Astra loves concessive and additive connectives that hold two considerations in balance simultaneously, producing an even-handed, both-sides rhythm.
themes.examples: while preserving, while leaving, while remaining, also matters, also supports, taken together these, together these features, matters but so

themes.description: Frequent low-commitment modals frame claims as possibilities rather than facts, reinforcing a cautious, advisory tone.
themes.examples: can reveal, can strengthen, can involve, can therefore, may involve, may become, may offer, can become more

themes.description: Constant use of comparatives ('more useful,' 'clearer,' 'stronger,' 'broader') positions every idea as an incremental upgrade over an implicit baseline, giving prose an optimizing, self-help quality.
themes.examples: more useful than, a clearer understanding, stronger foundation, the broader lesson, becomes more useful, a more consistent, matter more than, with greater confidence

themes.description: A heavy reliance on maximizing adverbs and superlative modifiers to inflate stakes and emotion, giving prose a breathless, marketing-adjacent register.
themes.examples: incredibly, deeply, heavily, profoundly, absolutely essential, highly anticipated, the absolute best, the sheer volume, is incredibly easy, entirely on

themes.description: Formulaic SEO-article framing that announces itself as a definitive walkthrough for the reader, complete with promises to 'explore' and 'walk you through.'
themes.examples: this comprehensive guide, the ultimate guide to, comprehensive guide we will, guide will walk you through, we will explore, this article explores, in this comprehensive guide, before diving into, let us explore

themes.description: Stock 'whether you are... or...' and 'if you are searching for' constructions that hail an imagined audience of seekers, hobbyists, or professionals.
themes.examples: whether you are a _ or, if you are _ for a, are searching for, you are searching, for anyone looking to, whether you need, you are planning, have you ever, you might wonder

themes.description: Repeated gestures toward hidden depth, cores, foundations, and secrets, framing ordinary topics as revelations of underlying truth.
themes.examples: a profound sense of, the secret lies in, at its core, the foundation of, deeply rooted in, the heart of this, lies in its, the magic of, a testament to

themes.description: A signature rhetorical move that dismisses a modest description in order to upgrade the subject to something grander or more consequential.
themes.examples: is not just a _ it is, more than just a _ it, no longer just a, far beyond the, much more than, does more than, goes far beyond, rather than just, is not about

themes.description: Framing subjects as pivotal moments of change, evolution, or paradigm shift, often with 'era,' 'landscape,' and 'path forward' language.
themes.examples: this shift in, a new era of, the landscape of, the transition from, paving the way, stepping into the, the path forward, shift in how, transforms, looking ahead to

themes.description: Preference for polished discourse markers and hedged transitions over conversational glue, signaling an essayistic, non-contracted register.
themes.examples: furthermore, ultimately, additionally the, instead it is, however a, more importantly, because of this, it is important to _ that, perhaps the most, it is helpful to

themes.description: Language of requirement, guarantee, and prioritization that positions the writer as an authoritative advisor dispensing best practices.
themes.examples: ensures that, ensuring your, requires a _ approach, by prioritizing, it requires a, is crucial for, is vital for, protecting your, must look at, top priority

human_themes.description: Human writers lean heavily on contractions in a way modern LLMs systematically avoid, giving prose a spoken, informal cadence.
human_themes.examples: we're, it's, can't, didn't, doesn't, aren't, we've, that's, i'm, you'll

human_themes.description: Frequent 'I', 'we', 'my', 'our' signals a personal, blog-style narrator who is present in the text rather than a detached explainer.
human_themes.examples: i, me, my, we, our, i just, with my, i think, one of my, of my favorite

human_themes.description: Colloquial softeners and boosters ('pretty', 'a bit', 'maybe') and enthusiastic adjectives ('amazing', 'huge') convey conversational stance instead of measured AI hedging.
human_themes.examples: pretty, maybe, probably, really, a bit, little bit, amazing, huge, definitely, super

human_themes.description: Journalistic attributions and title/role constructions signal news and profile writing, a genre AI outputs rarely replicate.
human_themes.examples: said, says, he said, said the, said that, director of, president of, vice president, new york times, told

human_themes.description: Approximate, chatty quantification ('a bunch of', 'lots of', 'a ton of') replaces the precise or structured lists AI models tend to produce.
human_themes.examples: lots of, a lot of, a bunch of, a ton of, a couple of, a number of, plenty of, kinds of, are so many, there are a _ of

human_themes.description: Direct 'you'-address plus soft imperatives create a how-to, advice-column tone aimed squarely at the reader.
human_themes.examples: you'll want to, if you're looking, make sure to, be sure to, let me know, feel free to, keep in mind, did you know, how do you, if you'd like

human_themes.description: Casual abbreviations, initials, and orthographic shortcuts ('etc', 'e g', bare letters) reflect human typing habits and OCR/tokenization artifacts absent from polished AI prose.
human_themes.examples: etc, e g, via, u s, p m, dr, g, x, and/or
